newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia condemns Jerusalem violence, raps Israel.
newsitem.headline: Russia condemns Jerusalem violence, raps Israel.

text.p: Russia blamed "unilateral" Israeli actions for violence with Palestinians but condemned "excesses" on both sides and said on Thursday it was trying to help reopen peace negotiations.

"The fact that the Israeli authorities, in a unilateral fashion, opened a tunnel next to a Moslem holy site...provoked a spontaneous protest by the Palestinian population," Foreign Ministry spokesman Mikhail Demurin told a news briefing.
"We express our deep regret over these excesses."

"Russia urgently calls on the interested parties to refrain from actions leading to a further deterioration in the situation," the spokesman added. "For this, it is essential that previous agreements be strictly observed."
Russia has been a joint-sponsor, with the United States, of the Middle East peace process.

"The Russian foreign ministry is undertaking essential steps and making contacts with the aim of getting the situation back to normal and encouraging dialogue and cooperation between the government of Israel and the Palestinian national administration," Demurin said.
